title: Electron Arrangement, Valency and Ions
summary: Electron shells (2, 8, 8), valence electrons, and how atoms lose or gain electrons to form ions.

cbse.chapter: Exploration (2026) Ch 8: Journey Inside the Atom
Earlier NCERT: Structure of the Atom

objectives: I can write electron arrangements for the first 20 elements.
I can work out valency from the number of outer electrons.
I can explain how atoms form positive and negative ions.
misconceptions: Valency is always the number of outer electrons.
Metals gain electrons to become positive.
An ion has a different number of protons from its atom.
